name: train_only_margin_threshold
purpose: ensure the margin threshold is learned only from training subjects inside each LOSO fold
pass_criterion: no held-out subject label contributes to threshold selection

name: within_subject_only_pairs
purpose: ensure every pair is within a single subject

name: non_tie_margin_filter_sufficiency
purpose: ensure filtering does not collapse pair availability
pass_criterion: each fold has enough eligible training and validation pairs after filtering

name: direction_balance_after_deterministic_downsampling
purpose: ensure pair direction is balanced after the selected rule
pass_criterion: training direction fraction is within [0.45,0.55] for every fold/task

name: fold_locality_and_loso_guard
purpose: ensure training and validation pair construction respects LOSO split
pass_criterion: validation pairs contain only the held-out subject and training pairs exclude it

name: reproducibility_guard
pass_criterion: same counts and thresholds are reproduced across repeated construction
